name: Anchovy Catchup
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: ten shalots, or very small onions
ingredients.originalText: ten shalots, or very small onions
ingredients.quantityText: ten shalots, or very small onions

ingredients.name: quarter of an ounce of mace
ingredients.originalText: a quarter of an ounce of mace

instructions.text: Bone two dozen anchovies, and then chop them
Put to them ten shalots, or very small onions, cut fine, and a handful of scraped horseradish, with a quarter of an ounce of mace
Add a lemon, cut into slices, twelve cloves, and twelve pepper-corns
Mix together a pint of port, a pint of madeira, and a pint of anchovy liquor
Put the other ingredients into the liquid, and boil it slowly till reduced one-half
Then strain it, and when cold put it into small bottles, securing the corks with leather

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Bone two dozen anchovies, and then chop them
2. Put to them ten shalots, or very small onions, cut fine, and a handful of scraped horseradish, with a quarter of an ounce of mace
3. Add a lemon, cut into slices, twelve cloves, and twelve pepper-corns
4. Mix together a pint of port, a pint of madeira, and a pint of anchovy liquor
5. Put the other ingredients into the liquid, and boil it slowly till reduced one-half
6. Then strain it, and when cold put it into small bottles, securing the corks with leather
